Alert.description: A threshold crossed (design system): context, runaway CPU, or memory or GPU against your limits.

text.description: What crossed, in the design system's words: 'GPU 21.4/20 GB', 'context 97%'.

Alert.title: Alert

AnswerRequest.description: Answer a pending request. For a question, `updated_input` carries the tool input plus `answers`.

message.description: Why it was denied: the session reads this.

remember.description: Allow and remember: add Claude Code's suggested allow rule.

mode.description: Plan approval: the mode to work in afterwards, such as acceptEdits.

AnswerRequest.title: AnswerRequest

kind.description: used, deferred (not in the window yet), buffer or free.

compactAt.description: Where auto-compact fires, as a share of the window.

Endpoint.description: A message peer that isn't a running session: one that exited, or a non-Claude sender.
Endpoint.title: Endpoint

EntriesEvent.description: New or updated entries (upsert by id). `reset`: too many to send; drop the cache and refetch.
EntriesEvent.title: EntriesEvent

Entry.description: One line of the message tree and the conversation. Full content: GET .../entries/{id}.

turn.description: Turn number; 0 before the first prompt.

starter.description: Starts a turn: a top-level row under the session in the tree.

text.description: First line: the prompt, tool name, peer name or reply text.

peer.description: For sent/received: the other side's name or address.

sessionId.description: The transcript this entry is in.

abandoned.description: On a branch a rewind left: not part of the conversation any more.

images.description: Prompts: the images sent with it (GET .../entries/{id}/images/{n}).

Entry.title: Entry

text.description: Everything the entry says, untruncated up to a size cap.

path.description: Relative to the session's folder; folders end in /.

FileMatches.description: `@` mentions: the project's files and folders that match, best first.
FileMatches.title: FileMatches

folder.description: What was typed is a folder.

matches.description: Folders that complete it, ending in /.

ForkLink.description: One end of a fork: the session it came from, or one made from it.

session.description: Node id, while that session runs.

at.description: Unix ms: where the record goes in the conversation.

ForkLink.title: ForkLink

settings.description: The settings file the hooks go in.

data.description: Base64, up to 5 MB decoded (the API's limit per image).

Limits.description: What a session may use before it's an alert (roadmap 4.5): 80% of a limit is a warning, past it critical.

memoryGb.description: Per session. Default: a quarter of this machine's memory.

gpuGb.description: Per session. Default: the GPU's memory. None without a GPU.

cpuPercent.description: Busy above this for 5 minutes is runaway CPU (a warning).

Limits.title: Limits

LimitsRequest.description: Change some limits; a field left out stays. `reset` puts every limit back to its default.
LimitsRequest.title: LimitsRequest

LinkMessage.description: A message between two sessions, as one of them recorded it.

session.description: Node id of the session whose transcript has it.

LinkMessage.title: LinkMessage

MessageRequest.description: A peer message to a session Constellation didn't start.
MessageRequest.title: MessageRequest

confirm.description: Bypass only: the session's name, the second key that names it.

value.description: What set_model takes: an alias ('opus') or a model id.

model.description: The model id the alias resolves to.

NoticeEvent.description: Something the server did on its own went wrong (adopting a session): shown until dismissed.
NoticeEvent.title: NoticeEvent

PastPrompt.description: A prompt from your history in that folder (~/.claude/history.jsonl), for C-r.
PastPrompt.title: PastPrompt

PastSession.description: A session in the resume picker (list_sessions).

running.description: Node id, when a live process has this session open.

PastSession.title: PastSession

PendingRequest.description: A question, permission prompt or plan approval a session is waiting on.

input.description: The tool's input: for a question, its `questions` list.

source.description: sdk: a managed session's, answered here. hook, transcript: a terminal session's, answered there.

PendingRequest.title: PendingRequest

queued.description: Prompts still waiting after this one: 0 means it was sent now.

Resources.description: What a session's process tree costs the machine (roadmap 4.1, 4.2), sampled every few seconds.

cpu.description: Percent of one core, now: 200 is two cores busy.

memory.description: Resident memory of the process tree, bytes.

gpu.description: GPU memory of the process tree, bytes. None without nvidia-smi.

processes.description: Processes in the tree: claude, its shells, MCP servers, dev servers.

cpuHistory.description: One value per minute, oldest first, up to 30: its average.

memoryHistory.description: One value per minute, oldest first, up to 30: its peak.

gpuHistory.description: As memory_history, for GPU memory. Empty without a GPU.

Resources.title: Resources

RewindPreview.description: What rewinding to a prompt restores: the files edited since, and which are outside the project.

turns.description: Turns that rewinding the conversation drops.

RewindPreview.title: RewindPreview

RewindRequest.description: Rewind to just before a prompt: its files, its conversation, or both.
RewindRequest.title: RewindRequest

SearchHit.description: GET /api/search: one message that matches, in the session it's in.
SearchHit.title: SearchHit

Session.description: One running Claude Code process. Its id stays the same across /clear; `session_id` changes.

id.description: Node id: '<pid>-<procStart>'. Stable for the life of the process.

sessionIds.description: Every session this process has had while watched, oldest first.

rawStatus.description: As the registry has it: busy, idle, shell, waiting.

lastActivityAt.description: Unix ms of the latest entry or status change.

step.description: Latest step: 'Edit src/app.ts', or the reply's first line.

costUsd.description: Managed: live, from the SDK. External: the last cost Claude Code recorded, not live.

model.description: The model in use: from the SDK when managed, else the last reply.

summary.description: Model-written one-liner, only after you ask for one.

summarySource.description: model: a small model wrote it. claude: Claude Code's own recap, current, so no call.

inbox.description: It has an inbox socket Constellation can send a peer message to.

adopting.description: Constellation resumes it here as soon as its terminal copy exits.

replaces.description: The node this one took over from: adopted, or restarted to rewind.

pending.description: Waiting for your answer: from the SDK (managed) or the hooks (terminal).

queued.description: Prompts waiting for the current turn to end.

activity.description: What Claude Code is busy with besides a turn: 'compacting'.

error.description: How the last turn failed, if it did.

effort.description: Set through Constellation; until then your settings' effort applies.

forks.description: Sessions forked here from this one.

costEstimated.description: Part of cost_usd is priced here from the transcript: Claude Code hasn't recorded it yet.

resources.description: None until the first sample, or when the process is gone.

alerts.description: The thresholds it has crossed, most severe first.

Session.title: Session

SessionOptions.description: What a managed session's / menu and model picker offer (from get_server_info).

effort.description: Set through Constellation, else the effortLevel in your settings.

SessionOptions.title: SessionOptions

lines.description: The last few prompts and replies.

partial.description: A huge transcript: only its end was read, so turns is a floor.

StartRequest.description: Start a managed session. No mode: your own default mode applies.

confirm.description: Bypass only: the folder's name, typed back.

StartRequest.title: StartRequest

TaskInfo.description: A background task of a managed session (a background command, a background subagent).
TaskInfo.title: TaskInfo

Totals.description: Across the machine, for the status bar.

todayUsd.description: Today's cost, from every transcript written to today. An estimate: Claude Code's side calls (titles, compaction) never reach a transcript.

Totals.title: Totals

UsageReport.description: GET /api/sessions/{id}/usage: tokens per turn and this process's split and cost (design system: /usage).

turns.description: The last 30 turns, oldest first, subagents included.

since.description: Unix ms: the process's start, which the totals below count from.

costUsd.description: As on the session: Claude Code's own figure where it has one.

byModel.description: Cost since the start per model, priced here.

UsageReport.title: UsageReport

description: Root for schema export: every type a client needs.
title: Protocol
